mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fk_reim_itinerary (id, main_id, subsidy_id, traveler_id, traveler_no, traveler_name, departure_date, arrival_date, departure_city, departure_city_no, arriving_city, arriving_city_no, itinerary_instructions) VALUES (#{id}, #{mainId}, #{subsidyId}, #{travelerId}, #{travelerNo}, #{travelerName}, #{departureDate}, #{arrivalDate}, #{departureCity}, #{departureCityNo}, #{arrivingCity}, #{arrivingCityNo}, #{itineraryInstructions})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fk_reim_itinerary WHERE main_id = #{mainId} ORDER BY departure_date
mapper.update: UPDATE fk_reim_itinerary SET traveler_id = #{travelerId}, traveler_no = #{travelerNo}, traveler_name = #{travelerName}, departure_date = #{departureDate}, arrival_date = #{arrivalDate}, departure_city = #{departureCity}, departure_city_no = #{departureCityNo}, arriving_city = #{arrivingCity}, arriving_city_no = #{arrivingCityNo}, itinerary_instructions = #{itineraryInstructions} WHERE id = #{id}
